Facts:
- Kelmarsh had 3,268 pupils and 11 schools in 2025/26. [NR-04]
- Redfen had 3,147 pupils and 10 schools in 2025/26. [NR-09]

Calculations:
- Kelmarsh pupils per school = 3,268 ÷ 11 = 297.090909...
- Redfen pupils per school = 3,147 ÷ 10 = 314.7
- Difference = 314.7 − 297.090909... = 17.609090... pupils per school
- Redfen has more pupils per school.

ANSWER: Redfen | 17.609
